rubrics.rubric: Is the Engineering Investigation Report delivered as a readable PDF with the required organization and calculation detail?
criterion: The deliverable is a readable PDF.
The six instructed main sections appear in the instructed order.
Reported numerical values include units.
Required deviations, variances, and comparisons show their calculation basis.

rubrics.rubric: Does the Datasheet Compatibility Check compare the factory test specification with the HAWE DZ25 limits?
criterion: The HAWE rated operating pressure is converted to units comparable with the test workbook.
Nominal, maximum operating, and proof test pressures are each compared with the HAWE rating.
The test-specification operating-temperature range is compared with the HAWE hydraulic-fluid temperature range.
The test-specification operating-temperature range is compared with the HAWE ambient temperature range.
Any upper- or lower-limit exceedance is explicitly identified.

rubrics.rubric: Does the Test Data Analysis completely and correctly analyze the supplied workbook?
criterion: The leakage matrix includes every leakage test point with pressure, measured rate, specification limit, PASS or FAIL, and deviation percent.
Leakage deviation percent is calculated as (measured - limit) divided by limit times 100.
Every pressure cycle whose Status is not PASS is listed with its status, extension pressure, retraction pressure, flow rate, and deviation from a stated normal or nominal range.
Each non-PASS cycle receives a source-grounded interpretation relevant to seal performance.
Every dimensional-inspection feature is shown with nominal, limits, measured value, deviation, tolerance utilization, and PASS or FAIL.
Every endurance parameter is shown with target, actual, absolute variance, and percent variance.

rubrics.rubric: Does the report present a defensible root cause and correlation determination?
criterion: The executive summary gives an explicit yes or no answer on correlation between field failures and factory anomalies.
The primary root cause is supported by measured evidence rather than by a required predetermined conclusion.
The wear mechanism connects the cited measured values to premature seal damage.
The analysis explains the significance of leakage behavior at higher test pressures.
The determination cross-references at least two supplied or required external sources.

rubrics.rubric: Does the Corrective Action Plan address the current batch and recurrence prevention with actions tied to the findings?
criterion: Immediate actions apply before shipment to the current production batch.
Inspection, segregation, rework, or rejection thresholds are tied to the measured nonconformities.
Process modifications address the demonstrated manufacturing or assembly causes.
Preventive controls specify a measurable verification method or acceptance gate.
Actions are concrete enough for production and quality management to implement.

rubrics.rubric: Does the Seal Kit Recommendation accurately use the HAWE DZ25 manufacturer documentation for the custom configuration?
criterion: The report cites the standard and low-friction seal kit part numbers for the 63 mm bore with the 36 mm rod option.
The report cites the standard and low-friction seal kit part numbers for the 63 mm bore with the 45 mm rod option.
The report explicitly notes that the cylinder's 40 mm rod is not one of those standard options.

The report gives an actionable, source-bounded recommendation for the custom 40 mm rod, such as obtaining a manufacturer-confirmed 63/40 custom kit or holding release until compatibility and a part number are confirmed, without presenting an unsupported standard kit as a direct fit.
The recommendation identifies the manufacturer documentation used.

rubrics.rubric: Does the Rod Reconditioning Procedure accurately apply the Degelman repair guidance?
criterion: The report cites inspection of the rod and other polished parts for burrs and scratches.
The report cites smoothing applicable damaged areas with emery cloth.
The procedure includes appropriate cleaning, inspection, and acceptance controls before reassembly.
The report does not imply that smoothing can correct an out-of-tolerance rod without verification.

rubrics.rubric: Does the Reassembly subsection use the Degelman piston locknut torque guidance without inventing an unsupported torque?
criterion: The report cites the Degelman piston locknut torque chart.
The report provides the applicable torque value when the locknut size is established.
If the supplied files do not establish locknut size, the report requires identification of the actual locknut thread before selecting the chart value.
The reassembly guidance includes lubrication or other directly applicable Degelman steps.

rubrics.rubric: Does the 3D Model Verification Summary compare STL-derived geometry with the cylinder specification?
criterion: The report states how dimensions were derived from the STL.
STL-derived overall and relevant cylinder dimensions are compared with the stated specification.
Any discrepancy or limitation caused by simplified geometry is documented.
The conclusion follows from the reported measurements.
